knowledge:
- key_parameters: bam=Path to BAM file or preprocessed BAM data object ;; targets=BED file path or GRanges object to subset reads of interest in preprocessBam ;; threshold.reads=Logical; if TRUE (default in generateCytosineReport), counts methylated cytosines from hypomethylated reads as unmethylated (VEF report). Set to FALSE for conventional beta value reports ;; filter.reads=Logical; if TRUE (default), drops reads with too few cytosines or high out-of-context methylation (recommended for short-read bisulfite/enzymatic sequencing to remove incomplete conversion) ;; min.mapq=Minimum mapping quality (recommended 30 for high quality) ;; min.baseq=Minimum base quality (recommended 13 or 20 for high quality) ;; min.prob=Minimum probability threshold for long-read base modifications (e.g., 178 for ONT) ;; nthreads=Number of decompression threads to speed up BAM/FASTA I/O ;; bed=BED file path or GRanges object for region-guided reports ;; vcf=Path to VCF file or VCF object for SNV association testing
- alternatives: Bismark / Illumina DRAGEN / BSMAP / bwa-meth=Short-read alignment and methylation calling tools. epialleleR can call methylation via callMethylation if BAM lacks XG/XM tags (like bwa-meth or BSMAP outputs) ;; Modkit=Oxford Nanopore's tool for pileup of modified bases. epialleleR is shown to have slightly higher accuracy on true positive/negative sites using the same thresholds
- when_to_use: Appropriate for next-generation sequencing (NGS) DNA methylation data (short-read bisulfite/EM-seq or long-read native DNA sequencing) to detect low-frequency hypermethylated epialleles (mosaic epimutations) at single-cytosine or region levels (amplicon, capture, BED).
- pitfalls: Paired-end BAM files must be sorted by QNAME (unsorted) instead of genomic location to perform read merging ;; Default generateVcfReport uses min.baseq=0 which can cause false SNVs due to misalignments; users should increase min.baseq (e.g., to 20) ;; Bisulfite conversion makes counting C->T variants on the "+" strand and G->A on the "-" strand impossible, resulting in NA values in VCF reports ;; Subsetting reads via targets in preprocessBam is currently performed without using a BAM index, which might be slow for very large files

workflows.name: short_read_methylation_analysis
workflows.intent: Preprocess short-read BAM files and generate cytosine-level or region-level (BED/capture) methylation reports.
input: capture.bam (short-read BAM file with XM/XG tags)
workflows.stages: 1. Preprocess BAM file using preprocessBam with target regions ;; 2. Generate cytosine-level VEF report using generateCytosineReport ;; 3. Generate conventional cytosine report (beta values) by setting threshold.reads=FALSE ;; 4. Generate region-level capture report using generateCaptureReport or generateBedReport ;; 5. Generate linearized Methylated Haplotype Load (lMHL) report using generateMhlReport
workflows.code:
capture.bam <- system.file("extdata", "capture.bam", package="epialleleR")
capture.bed <- system.file("extdata", "capture.bed", package="epialleleR")
bam.data    <- preprocessBam(capture.bam, targets=capture.bed)
generateCytosineReport(bam.data)
cg.vef.report <- generateCytosineReport(bam.data)
cg.report <- generateCytosineReport(bam.data, threshold.reads=FALSE)
cx.report <- generateCytosineReport(bam.data, threshold.reads=FALSE, report.context="CX")
capture.report <- generateCaptureReport(bam=system.file("extdata", "capture.bam", package="epialleleR"), bed=system.file("extdata", "capture.bed", package="epialleleR"))
bed.report <- generateBedReport(bam=system.file("extdata", "capture.bam", package="epialleleR"), bed=system.file("extdata", "capture.bed", package="epialleleR"), bed.type="capture")
mhl.report <- generateMhlReport(bam=system.file("extdata", "capture.bam", package="epialleleR"))

workflows.name: long_read_methylation_analysis
workflows.intent: Preprocess long-read BAM files (with MM/ML tags) and generate cytosine-level reports and methylation patterns.
input: longread.bam (long-read BAM file with MM/ML tags)
workflows.stages: 1. Preprocess long-read BAM using preprocessBam with quality and probability filters ;; 2. Generate cytosine-level report using generateCytosineReport with threshold.reads=FALSE ;; 3. Extract and plot methylation patterns using extractPatterns and plotPatterns
workflows.code:
longread.data <- preprocessBam(system.file("extdata", "longread.bam", package="epialleleR"), min.mapq=30, min.baseq=20, min.prob=178)
generateCytosineReport(longread.data, threshold.reads=FALSE)
long.bam <- system.file("extdata", "longread.bam", package="epialleleR")
long.bed <- as("chr17:43124909-43125554", "GRanges")
long.data <- preprocessBam(bam=long.bam, targets=long.bed, clip.to.targets=TRUE, min.mapq=30, min.baseq=20, min.prob=178)
plotPatterns(extractPatterns(bam=long.data, bed=long.bed), npatterns.per.bin=Inf)

workflows.name: methylation_calling_unannotated_bams
workflows.intent: Call cytosine methylation and add XG/XM tags to BAM files lacking them (e.g., from bwa-meth or BSMAP).
workflows.stages: 1. Preprocess reference genome using preprocessGenome ;; 2. Call methylation and write to a new BAM file using callMethylation
workflows.code:
input.bam <- system.file("extdata", "test", "bwameth-se-unsort-yd.bam", package="epialleleR")
output.bam <- tempfile(pattern="output-", fileext=".bam")
genome <- preprocessGenome(system.file("extdata", "test", "reference.fasta.gz", package="epialleleR"))
callMethylation(input.bam, output.bam, genome)

workflows.name: sequence_variant_association
workflows.intent: Test the association between single nucleotide variants (SNVs) and epiallelic status.
workflows.stages: 1. Generate VCF report using generateVcfReport with specified mapping/base quality thresholds and style ;; 2. Sort or filter the report by Fisher's exact test p-values (FEp- or FEp+)
workflows.code:
vcf.report <- generateVcfReport(bam=system.file("extdata", "amplicon010meth.bam", package="epialleleR"), bed=system.file("extdata", "amplicon.bed", package="epialleleR"), vcf=system.file("extdata", "amplicon.vcf.gz", package="epialleleR"), min.mapq=30, min.baseq=20, vcf.style="NCBI")
head(vcf.report[order(`FEp-`, na.last=TRUE)])
head(vcf.report[order(`FEp+`, na.last=TRUE)])

workflows.name: methylation_bimodality_ecdf
workflows.intent: Visualize per-read beta value distributions and empirical cumulative distribution functions (eCDFs) to assess bimodality.
workflows.stages: 1. Compute eCDFs for within- and out-of-context per-read beta values using generateBedEcdf ;; 2. Plot the eCDFs for context and out-of-context
